reviews.text:
So having a large breed such as my 115# cane corso it’s challenging to find a true kennel that understands and can handle a Corso.
Well Mark and his wife Ronnie do a amazing job!
Mark being a legit dog trainer really put me at ease as i rarely leave my dog in a kennel. They are not overstocked with dogs and inexperienced handlers
This will be ONLY kennel i ever go to!!!
Thank you Mark and Ronnie 💪🏼😎🙏🏼🇺🇸 🐕

We highly recommend 9 Line K9 Academy,  you will not be disappointed. Mark & Ronni are an awesome Team,  thank you both very much.  We opted for a two-week board and train for our nine-month-old Female Aussiedoodle "Harley". The results were absolutely amazing. We continue to reinforce the training at home and by attending the Saturday morning group training. These sessions are great for helping owners gain knowledge and coaching advice from Mark. The group trainings are designed to work through a multitude of scenarios alongside other dogs and their owners, priceless. We made a wise investment for our beloved puppy dog Harley and our family!
We left Walter with Mark for 3 weeks and love the results!

Stay far away from 9 Line K9 unless you want your dog returned in this condition. This occurred over thanks giving and 9 Line K9 refuse to cover the medical bills, the cost of the stay at their facility or provide an apology.

Mark & Ronni are miracle workers! We brought in our 13 month old, 130 lb, Great Dane puppy Jasper, who had no manners whatsoever. You could not walk him on a leash, he dragged us on the leash. He would run and jump at us, constantly try to chew on our arms, and had severe separation anxiety. He was totally uncontrollable around new people or other animals. We picked up Jasper 3 weeks later and it was the most wonderful transformation I have ever seen. He walks on a loose leash, no pulling us, no chewing on our arms, no jumping on us, just totally calm puppy who listens to us and shows no signs of anxiety at all. I highly recommend them if you need training for your dog!

We have a 1 yr old golden retriever who is the most destructive dog we have had and he is our 4th golden.  Bo is also one of the most loveable Goldens we have ever had! My wife and I were at wits end with his destructive and bad behavior such as jumping, counter surfing and chewing. We had a friend suggest training and because we have full time jobs and a young family we decided on doing boarding and training wuth Bo.  When we looked at websites we didn't know exactly what to look for and we came upon 9 line dog academy just by chance.  I Called the number and to my surprise on a Saturday morning at 830 Ronni one of the owners answered the phone and she was honest and funny on the phone and we made an appointment for us to evaluate Bo.  We met with Ronnie and Mark at their facility and they were great and they explained their training methods and their recommendations with Bo.  We dropped off Bo for the three weeks of training abd every Thursday  they called us with an update of his training and how he has progressed.   On the third week they sent  us a video on his training and how far he progressed and it was phenomenal how well he was performing all of the things that he was trained to do.  We showed up to pick Bo up on tge third week and they had Bo do all of things he had learned and walked us through how to continue to work with him to keep tge things he learned fresh and repeatable.
I can say that the Bo we left in the beginning of those three weeks was a happy go lucky golden retriever that was the most destructive dog we had have had  came back still a happy go lucky golden retriever that is a lot more well behaved and trained dog.  They gave him the foundation that I never could. If you are considering something like this for your dog hands down 1000 percent 9 line dog academy is your go to.

I brought my 3 year old, female GSD to 9 line for obedience training. I was able to teach some things at home, she knew the basic commands and basically how to walk on leash but I knew I needed professional help to make her even better. She stayed for 3-weeks. Best money ever spent. She LOVED being with Ronni and Mark. She now walks perfectly on leash, has better recall than any dog I’ve seen, the best “place” command, and is so much more confident in herself. 10/10 recommend for any age dog! Old dogs can learn new tricks and Mark knows how to do it!

We were in Phoenix from out of town for a wedding. Our dog travels with us a lot, and has rarely been boarded, so finding a kennel in another city was nerve-racking. When we arrived at 9 Line K9 we were immediately put at ease. The facility is amazing, we have never seen better. Our Ettie is an escape artist, and there was zero possibility she could get loose. We were also very reassured by the fact that she bonded with the owner immediately. If we are ever in the area again, we would definitely use 9 Line K9!

We took a very energetic, kinda crazy puppy and picked up a calm, eager to please, well behaved puppy. Mark & Ronnie are awesome. We are thankful for the work they put into teaching Taco good manners. We will continue to work with him at home and follow up with Mark & Ronnie for training classes. We look forward to seeing Taco grow and become an even more awesome, well mannered dog. Thank you Mark & Ronnie.

Mark and Ronni have been great to work with.  Mark helped our Havamalt (Maltese + Havanese), Bruni, gain more confidence by taking him to a variety of places.  I felt very comfortable leaving Bruni with them and he is clearly very fond of both of them.  I especially appreciate the follow up group lessons that are included with the board and train. We get great practice, we learn a lot and Bruni gets safe exposure to other dogs. Their prices are very reasonable and their facilities are wonderful.  We appreciated working with a fellow veteran.

We just picked up our sweet Bode, a 16 month old Labrador Retriever, from 3 weeks of training.  We are so pleased and excited to have an obedient Bode!!  We just spent 2 hours with Mark & Ronnie going through commands with Bode.  We took turns walking Bode, having him sit, down, here, and let’s go.  I’m amazed at how well our lively, excitable grown puppy is doing!!

We get 2 more private lessons and 8 group lessons to reinforce the training (especially for my husband and me!).

Next month, we will be sending our 6 year old red heeler - catahoula hound mix female, Honey, for training.

Looking forward to calmer household!!

I am so impressed with the change in Bode, and appreciate the wonderful care they gave Bode during his 3 weeks there.  Thank you, Mark & Ronnie so much!! We highly recommend them to anyone looking to getting their dog trained.
I highly recommend 9 Line K9 academy to anyone looking for a place to get their dog trained. They love what they do and they really treat your dog like their own and the results are amazing.
Can’t say enough good things about Ronni and Mark. Frieda is doing awesome and loves them. We’ve done training and boarding with them. Highly recommend them.

We have used multiple boarding places throughout the years, but no one can top 9 Line so far. I can't think of a better or more comfortable place to send your beloved animals to. Our dogs are pandemic dogs so they never got very social so we were nervous about their first stay there. But they handled it like a champ and that's quite the testament to Mark and Ronni's care and love for animals. We quickly chose them for our next boarding stay with no regrets. Again, the dogs were well cared for and maintained. The facilities themselves are top notch and well taken care of. You can tell these guys are in it for the love of the animals and not just glorified babysitters. The prices are also well below what we have experienced in almost all other boarding experiences. Your animals are not going to just be stuck in a small cage the entire time either. They get interacted with regularly and have plenty of access to outside time (with NO upcharge for it like so many other boarding places!). Mark and Ronni are simply just wonderful people who make the experience so stress-free and comfortable for everyone involved. I just can't recommend these guys enough. Since my wife and I are avid cruisers, it's just a matter of time before we're calling on them again. Oh and they allowed us to use Affirm to pay for the boarding which was an amazing surprise and makes the whole process SO much more manageable. Just awesome!
Excellent facility. Clean. Mark and Roni were so great with my dogs. We were late picking them up and it was no biggy. We will use these guys again!
Awesome people  and great facility.  Thank you guys for taking such great care of Bear. You guys are life savers and I greatly appreciate your services.

Mark was a life saver when our lab rescue boys started having dominance issues with each other. I called other trainers in the area and they advised me to return the latest one to the rescue.
My one boy is just shy of 100# and Jacky Boy is 107# so that is a lot of dog to try and manage.
Not Mark, he said when can you come for a meet and greet? Took me in the next day as we were heading out of town that weekend and he saved the day. Since then we have used them for training, boarding and board and train. GAME CHANGER!
I can't say enough about how well our dogs are treated at this facility. We were not about to give up on our boys and Mark is still helping us to this day. SO HAPPY to have them as a trusted resource for our beloved fur babies. And Veteran owned.

Mark and Ronnie are beyond amazing.  We could tell right from the start that we were sending Penelope “Penny” to the right place for Board and Train.  Mark provided us with so much information about her training, including weekly videos on her progress.  When we picked Penny up we saw a huge improvement.  But our relationship with Mark and Ronnie continues with group and individual classes, which we look forward to going to.  Not only does this help us with Penny’s training, but we get to meet some great people and their pups who are also there for continue training.  Everyone there loves the results they have seen with 9linek9.

We’ve taken our Boxer, Hilo, to 9 Line K9 Academy a few times now, and every experience has been great. Mark and his team take excellent care of him — Hilo is always excited the moment we pull up and comes home happy and relaxed every time. It’s clear he feels comfortable there, and we have total peace of mind leaving him in their care. We’re also planning to enroll him in their training camp soon since he’s done so well with them. Highly recommend!

We highly recommend 9Line K9 Academy for dog training & boarding.  The owners are great to work with and Mark is a highly knowledgeable trainer.  Our rescue Belgian Malinois started with a few private lessons due to being shy & timid, then did a 3 week Board & Train.  She came home more confident, calmer and with solid OB.  We now attend group classes in an effort to get her more dog & people neutral and they are alot of fun.  This is a great Veteran owned, small business that we are proud to support.  The property & kennels are clean, neat & organized and just the right size, so no overcrowding. So happy we found 9Line K9 Academy, as the owners are very special people who love dogs and train them for success!  Ava thanks you too!

9 Line is amazing! If you have a dog, and if you love your dog, send them here!

Our journey with 9 Line K9 started with a recommendation from our long-time pet-sitter, who was not equipped to handle our crazy new puppy. Her recommendation carried a lot of weight, so we gave them a try. We boarded our spastic shark for a few days and the care and dedication were immediately apparent. Though he was only there for boarding, the trainers proactively worked with our puppy, working on some fundamental skills and showing genuine love for him—a level of commitment that truly stood out. They gave us a lot of information about our dog, based on their experience, helping us understand what his needs would be and how we could work with him to benefit all of us.

This incredible initial experience led us to enroll in the 3-Week Board and Train Program. Since completing it, our dog’s transformation has been amazing, and our household is significantly more peaceful. We especially appreciated the photo and video updates, which allowed us to follow his progress and stay connected.

The results are undeniable. Out in public, people frequently comment on how well-behaved our high energy puppy is, especially for his age and breed. One of the best skills they trained on is recall, critical for his safety, and he is ON IT.

Mark and Ronni's ongoing support through the included group training sessions is invaluable. These small-group classes offer personalized attention and have accelerated our puppy's progress. They encourage (and train - it's the people who need trained!) the whole family to work with the dogs. It’s motivating to train alongside long-term clients with amazingly focused dogs, some of whom started with significant challenges. That is inspiring to see how continued practice and development will get us to (hopefully) the best behaved and skilled dog we've ever had.

The training philosophy is balanced, promoting strong leadership while incentivizing learning through positive reinforcement. Crucially, the approach ensures the dog's high-energy spirit is not broken, but channeled into excellent behavior.

Their facility is modern, clean, and safe. We also greatly valued the specific nutrition and growth recommendations provided, showing their commitment to our puppy’s overall health and development. Their professional experience with dogs, patience with both the dogs and owners, is really encouraging. And they are there to help when we need it. It's like we've joined an exclusive club to help us train our chaos-hound into a pleasant family member.

It's not all roses... you have to put in the work, and he's still a puppy. This isn't a magic bullet, but the potential is there, and Mark and Ronni are there, and we can and will survive puppy-hood and come out of it with a great companion.

If you have a high-drive dog and seek comprehensive, compassionate, and life-changing training, we cannot recommend 9 Line K9 enough.
Great experience with Mark and Ronni! Foxy needed some refining on her skills! Leash pulling and recall were our main goals. She is a little rock star.

9 Line K9 Academy is great. They transformed our newly adopted highly energetic Aussie pup into the friendliest dog in the world. Transformational! Still energetic but, completely manageable! Mark and Ronni Know what they are doing!
We have boarded our dogs twice and will do it again when we leave town next.  Mark takes such good care of them. This makes it easier to leave them knowing they will be well cared for.

Owners are super nice! I boarded both my dogs with them while I was away. We originally had them in separate kennels. The owners realized one of my dogs seemed upset being separated from my other dog so they put them together and it fixed everything! I was able to see the kennel space which was spotless clean. The dogs have access to both inside with air conditioning and outside. I have not used them for training, but know other people that have and have had fabulous results. The owners are very caring and accommodating.
So happy I found this place! I was very hesitant looking for a place to board my 2 dogs. I love feeling that my dogs are not looked over and are being taken care of. I am definitely using them again!

Mark and Ronni took wonderful care of our Luna well we were away for 5 days. We originally dropped her off at another boarding location, after dropping her off we turned around and picked her up as the state of the facility was awful. Frantically looking for somewhere as we were leaving that evening for a trip we stumbled across Mark and Ronni. They were exceptionally well priced for the 5 day stay with them. The facility was in top tier cleanliness, she had her own kennel along side the others and could not see the other dogs which we liked.  Our girl Luna was very stressed as it was her first time in such a situation. We were also stressed as it was out first time having to board her somewhere. Mark and Ronni put our minds at ease the moment we arrived to drop her off. They showed great compassion for our baby and have a genuine care for every animal that walks through their doors. We will definitely be using them again

Let me start with saying Mark and Ronni are great people and truly care about your dog!

Their facility is clean and well maintained. The orientation was educational and they showed that they care about helping you and your dog from the very start, despite your furry companions demeanor ( sorry for the little nibble)

They took in our little Bandit who is a puppy with an attitude. After 3 weeks he had shown some remarkable changes. We are now 2 months post graduation and he is doing good, but still has his puppy moments. Mark and Ronni are quick to give help with corrections as we continue to work with our teenage brained puppy.

The ongoing training is a must and helps maintain and reinforce what they learn while training..

We would highly recommend 9 Line K9 Academy to anyone because they care and treat you like family!
9 line is the best! We will not take our girl anywhere else. Mark is patient and structured with her. Highly, highly recommend for training and boarding.
Mark and Ronnie are the best! I don’t trust my dogs with very many people, and I 100% trust Mark and Ronnie with my boys.  If you are looking for training, or boarding Mark is the man to talk to!

The 9 Line team did a great job training my puppy. He’s a nervous dog with a lot of energy. He has grasped basic and advanced commands. They helped him master impulse control and he does great on the leash. He’s great in public spaces and does great on walks.

Mark and Ronnie are great. The free evaluation already taught George and I so many things. I could see that George bonded with Mark immediately which may me feel very confident leaving him in his care for boarding and training. We learned how to continue the training at home and they have been available for questions and help which we have needed. I will continue to go to the classes and board him there in the future.

9linek9 is absolutely amazing! They have completely helped us out with our 1 year old Belgian Malinois/Doberman mix (who can be quite the handful). They are such a great team and we love continuing our pups education with the group classes! …

Nine Line K9 is amazing !
It’s immaculately clean.
Mark and Ronni are amazing. …
